lyrics: Midnight hums in shades of blue
A map unwritten, waiting to be drawn anew
sequences.visual: Wide empty horizon, starfield, map on ground faint

lyrics: I walk where the streetlight loses its name
Learning the language of a different rain
Each wrong turn leaves a mark on my sleeve
Proof of the roads I was scared to believe
sequences.visual: Streetlight close, rain vertical streaks, sleeve fabric close

lyrics: The horizon moves, so I move with it too
Past all the rules that never came true
I wear the unknown like a second skin
Keeping one small match alive in the wind
sequences.visual: Horizon parallax 12px, match flame emissive 11 as anchor

lyrics: Still I rise before the fade
Still I chase the light I made
Out on the edge where tomorrow waits
I'm becoming what tomorrow makes
sequences.visual: Hero mantra, crystal bloom mirror ground, light leak 0.16

lyrics: Deep in the fog, I found a steadier hand
Every river redrew where I stand
I keep small hours like coins in my coat
Warm from the crossing, enough to stay afloat
sequences.visual: Fog 0.55 + depth haze, steadier reduced jitter

lyrics: They watched from the shore while I learned to swim
Now even the tide has changed its hymn
Softer than thunder, clear as the glass
I build what will stay when the old days pass
sequences.visual: Shore flat, tide wave thicker 1.2px, glass clear
